## Checklist

- [ ] `make check` passes
- [ ] New migration? Rebased on `main` before creating it, and reviewed the generated file
- [ ] API schema changed? Ran `make api-types` and committed `openapi.json` + `schema.d.ts`
- [ ] Touched shared code (`backend/app/core`, `backend/app/shared`, `frontend/src/lib`, `@/ui` props)? Announced to the team
- [ ] Adds a new external data source or API? Documented in `docs/DECISIONS.md` (we use no Google API, TikTok or Gemini)
- [ ] UI uses only `@/ui` components and token classes
